summary.text: Greg Wims is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 39 who has served since May 2, 2023, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former Montgomery County government official and longtime communications and public affairs professional, he serves on the Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: Greg Wims was born in Bethesda, Maryland, on September 2, 1949, and graduated from Montgomery High School in 1968 and attended Montgomery College, according to his General Assembly biography.

He was a Head Start teacher with Montgomery County Public Schools from 1974 to 1976, chief legislative officer for U.S. Representative Newton Steers from 1976 to 1978, and legislative assistant to Representative Melvin H. Evans from 1979 to 1981.

He has been director of public affairs at Bold Concepts, Inc. since 1986, founded the Victims' Rights Foundation in 1996, and served as UpCounty Regional Services Director for Montgomery County Government from 2022 to 2024.
Ballotpedia reports that Wims was appointed to the House of Delegates on April 18, 2023, to replace Kirill Reznik.
He has served on the Ways and Means Committee since 2023 and is a Deputy Majority Whip in 2026.
Ballotpedia reports that he advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary.
